executiveSummary: High-urgency incidents this period include an AI-assisted cyberattack on the European Commission that forced multiple internal applications offline, signaling escalated offensive AI use against government infrastructure View Article . Coinbase intercepted roughly $4.7 million in attempted transfers during a widely viewed Elon Musk deepfake livestream scam, underscoring the operational maturity of real-time financial fraud using synthetic video View Article . The FBI detailed a North Korea-linked scheme using imposter video meetings and recorded webcam footage to facilitate over $400 million in crypto theft, highlighting blended social engineering and media manipulation techniques View Article . Researchers and platforms documented large-scale influence campaigns using stolen faces, synthetic voices, and altered lip movements to target political audiences in Canada and the United States, with weak platform labeling and moderation performance reported Source Supporting Report . OpenAI also reported disrupting AI-enabled false-front operations tied to Russian and Iranian actors producing propaganda content at scale View Article . Defensively, governments and standards bodies advanced provenance and detection initiatives: UK authorities announced a deepfake detection evaluation capability, NIST published new guidance for mobile driver's license enrollment protections, and cross-jurisdictional disclosure and labeling requirements continued to develop Source Supporting Report Supporting Report . However, new research demonstrated black-box evasion of multiple speech-watermarking systems, cautioning against overreliance on watermarking alone View Article . Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening, driven by confirmed government-targeted attacks using AI, high-reach financial scams with measurable loss attempts, and persistent influence operations using synthetic personas and media. Concurrent defensive and regulatory developments are material but not yet sufficient to offset observed offensive momentum.
